# Message

One message of a conversation. User messages are right-aligned in a bubble with a neutral fill; assistant
messages are left-aligned without a bubble and use the full width, optionally with an avatar and a name. Place
it in MessageList.

**Interaction**: while a reply is generated and still empty, "Generating" appears after 200 ms (no flash for
fast replies; the indicator is static when motion is reduced). A failed reply keeps the text received so far and
adds a note with "Retry"; a stopped reply adds "Stopped". The actions appear on hover or when keyboard focus
enters the message, without changing the height of the message (their place is kept); on touch screens and with
`showActions="always"` they are always visible.

**Category**: AI · **Common uses**: Messages of an AI chat, replies with copy and retry, failed or stopped generations

## Import

```ts
import { Message } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

The user message is right-aligned in a bubble; the reply is left-aligned with an avatar and a name, and its
actions appear on hover or keyboard focus.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Stack gap={4}>
      <Message author="user">{QUESTION}</Message>
      <Message
        author="assistant"
        name="Assistant"
        meta="10:42"
        avatar={<Avatar name="Assistant" icon="sparkles" size={28} />}
        actions={<MessageActions copyText={ANSWER} onRetry={() => {}} />}
      >
        {ANSWER}
      </Message>
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Actions always visible

`showActions="always"` keeps the actions of the latest reply visible, so they can be found without hovering.

```tsx
export function AlwaysVisible() {
  return (
    <Message
      author="assistant"
      showActions="always"
      actions={<MessageActions copyText={ANSWER} onFeedbackChange={() => {}} />}
    >
      {ANSWER}
    </Message>
  )
}
```

## States

### Generating, failed and stopped

An empty reply that is still generating shows "Generating" after 200 ms. A failed reply keeps what was received
and offers "Retry"; a stopped reply is marked "Stopped".

```tsx
export function States() {
  return (
    <Stack gap={4}>
      <Message author="assistant" status="streaming" />
      <Message author="assistant" status="error" onRetry={() => {}}>
        Here is a short plan for the
      </Message>
      <Message author="assistant" status="stopped">
        The first step is to freeze the scope
      </Message>
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `author` | `'user' \| 'assistant'` | Who wrote the message: `user` messages are right-aligned in a bubble, `assistant` messages are left-aligned without a bubble and use the full width. | — | Yes |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | The content: plain text (line breaks are kept) or rendered content such as Markdown. While `status` is `streaming` and there is no content yet, a loading indicator is shown instead. | — | No |
| `name` | `string` | Name of the author, shown above the content and used as the accessible name of the message. Without it, nothing is shown and screen readers read "You" or "Assistant". | — | No |
| `avatar` | `ReactNode` | Avatar of an assistant message, usually an Avatar with `size={28}`; shown to the left of the content. | — | No |
| `meta` | `ReactNode` | Secondary information next to the name, such as the time or the model. | — | No |
| `status` | `'done' \| 'streaming' \| 'error' \| 'stopped'` | State: `streaming` while the reply is generated (an empty reply shows "Generating" after 200 ms, actions are hidden), `error` adds a failure note (with "Retry" when `onRetry` is set), `stopped` adds a "Stopped" note. | `'done'` | No |
| `error` | `ReactNode` | Explanation shown when `status` is `error`; "Couldn't generate a reply" by default. | — | No |
| `onRetry` | `() => void` | Shows "Retry" in the failure note and calls this function when it is pressed. | — | No |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` | Actions below the content, usually MessageActions. Not shown while `status` is `streaming`. | — | No |
| `showActions` | `'hover' \| 'always'` | When the actions are visible: `hover` on hover or keyboard focus (always on touch screens), `always` for example on the last message. | `'hover'` | No |

Also accepts `testId` (rendered as `data-testid`), `aria-label`, `role` and `id`, like all primitives.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
